The target is set to the center of the scaffolding cluster at spawn-relative (11, 1, 10), with max_distance=5 so the player must get reasonably close (spawn is ~15 blocks away, so this can't be satisfied from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 degrees to confirm they are looking at the scaffolding. An oak fence line and lantern provide visual landmarks to guide the player toward the structure. The scaffolding is clearly visible from spawn through the open sides of the structure.
task_text: Find the scaffolding blocks in the scene. Look around and walk toward the scaffolding.
design_notes: Scaffolding is placed at ~11,0,10 (center, 4 tall) with flanking 2-tall stacks at ~10,0,10 and ~12,0,10. The structure is ~11 blocks from spawn (reachable in 20 steps). The area is cleared of trees via /fill air to ensure visibility. The cobblestone floor, oak log pillars, and roof create a 'construction site' context for the scaffolding. Oak fence and lantern serve as waypoints.
